result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates invoice and material transaction data to measure customer monetization and revenue performance.
result_preview.description: This data product synthesizes invoice transactions and material consumption patterns to provide comprehensive revenue insights across customer segments. It summarizes customer lifetime value, material-driven profitability trends, and campaign-driven purchase behavior to optimize sales strategies and financial performance tracking. The analytics enable organizations to correlate customer engagement investments with tangible invoice outcomes and material sales attribution.
